title: Inner Game of Tennis
summary: A 1970 demonstration of W. Timothy Gallwey, author of The Inner Game of Tennis, teaching a complete beginner to play tennis in about ten minutes. He chats with her, feeds balls and gives positive feedback instead of instruction.
why: HN commenters use it as a vivid demonstration of learning by quieting the conscious mind, and recommend it alongside the book.

quote.text: This video of Timothy Gallwey teaching a woman how to play tennis. In 5 minutes.
